arxiv-2102-00925.title: Neural representation and generation for RNA secondary structures
arxiv-2102-00925.creator: Zichao Yan, William L. Hamilton, Mathieu Blanchette
arxiv-2102-00925.description: Abstract Our work is concerned with the generation and targeted design of RNA, a type of genetic macromolecule that can adopt complex structures which influence their cellular activities and functions. The design of large scale and complex biological structures spurs dedicated graph-based deep generative modeling techniques, which represents a key but underappreciated aspect of computational drug discovery.

arxiv-2105-09482.title: Translating solutions for a class of quasilinear parabolic initial boundary value problems in Lorentz-Minkowski plane ℝ 1 2 \mathbb{R}^{2}_{1} Thanks: ∗ \ast Corresponding author
arxiv-2105-09482.creator: Ya Gao, Jing-Hua Li, Jing Mao ∗
arxiv-2105-09482.description: Abstract . In this paper, we investigate the evolution of spacelike curves in Lorentz-Minkowski plane ℝ 1 2 \mathbb{R}^{2}_{1} along prescribed geometric flows (including the classical curve shortening flow or mean curvature flow as a special case), which correspond to a class of quasilinear parabolic initial boundary value problems, and can prove that this flow exists for all time.

arxiv-2109-02403.title: Eliminating Sentiment Bias for Aspect-Level Sentiment Classification with Unsupervised Opinion Extraction
arxiv-2109-02403.creator: Bo Wang, Tao Shen, Guodong Long, Tianyi Zhou, Yi Chang
arxiv-2109-02403.description: Abstract Aspect-level sentiment classification (ALSC) aims at identifying the sentiment polarity of a specified aspect in a sentence. ALSC is a practical setting in aspect-based sentiment analysis due to no opinion term labeling needed, but it fails to interpret why a sentiment polarity is derived for the aspect.

arxiv-2209-01001.title: String-like Theory of Quantum Hall Interfaces
arxiv-2209-01001.creator: Oğuz Türker, Kun Yang
arxiv-2209-01001.description: Abstract We derive the effective theories for quantum hall droplets with attractive interaction among the constituent particles. In the absence of confining potentials such droplets are defined by their freely moving interfaces (or boundaries) with the vacuum. We demonstrate the effective theories take forms similar to string theories. Generalization to interfaces between different quantum Hall liquids is discussed.

arxiv-2212-09540.title: Decagonal Sn clathrate on d d -Al-Ni-Co
arxiv-2212-09540.creator: Vipin Kumar Singh 1 , Eva Pospisilova 2 , Marek Mihalkovič 2† , Marian Krajčí 2∗ , Pramod Bhakuni 1 , Shuvam Sarkar 1 , Katariina Pussi 3 , D. L. Schlagel 4 , T. A. Lograsso 4 , Paul C. Canfield 4,5 , Sudipta Roy Barman 1#
arxiv-2212-09540.description: Abstract Decagonal quasiperiodic ordering of Sn thin film on d d -Al-Ni-Co is shown based on scanning tunneling microscopy (STM), low-energy electron diffraction and density functional theory (DFT). Interestingly, the decagonal structural correlations are partially retained up to a large film thickness of 10 nm grown at a 165 ± \pm 10 K.

arxiv-2409-08637.title: Space Charge and Future Light Sources
arxiv-2409-08637.creator: S. A. Antipov 1, V. Gubaidulin 2, I. Agapov 1, E. C. Cortés García 1, A. Gamelin 2
arxiv-2409-08637.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by S. A. Antipov 1, V. Gubaidulin 2, I. Agapov 1, E. C. Cortés García 1, A. Gamelin 2. It is a truth universally acknowledged, that space charge effects in ultrarelativistic electron storage rings are irrelevant due to the steep inverse dependence of their strength on the Lorentz factor. Yet, with the push towards the diffraction limit, the state-of-the-art light sources are approaching the point where their emittance becomes so small that the space charge force can no longer be ignored.

arxiv-2508-00413.title: DC-AE 1.5: Accelerating Diffusion Model Convergence with Structured Latent Space
arxiv-2508-00413.creator: Junyu Chen, Dongyun Zou, Wenkun He, Junsong Chen, Enze Xie, Song Han, Han Cai
arxiv-2508-00413.description: Abstract We present DC-AE 1.5, a new family of deep compression autoencoders for high-resolution diffusion models. Increasing the autoencoder’s latent channel number is a highly effective approach for improving its reconstruction quality. However, it results in slow convergence for diffusion models, leading to poorer generation quality despite better reconstruction quality.

arxiv-2508-09887.title: The Role of Symmetry in Generalized Hong-Ou-Mandel Interference and Quantum Metrology
arxiv-2508-09887.creator: Éloi Descamps, Arne Keller, Pérola Milman
arxiv-2508-09887.description: Abstract The Hong-Ou-Mandel interferometer is a foundational tool in quantum optics, with both fundamental and practical significance. Earlier works identified that input-state symmetry under exchange of the two spatial modes is fundamental in the understanding of the Hong-Ou-Mandel effect. We now show that this notion of symmetry is central to generalizing this effect.

arxiv-2601-04925.title: Can AI-Generated Persuasion Be Detected? Persuaficial Benchmark and AI vs. Human Linguistic Differences
arxiv-2601-04925.creator: Arkadiusz Modzelewski, Paweł Golik, Anna Kołos, Giovanni Da San Martino
arxiv-2601-04925.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate highly persuasive text, raising concerns about their misuse for propaganda, manipulation, and other harmful purposes. This leads us to our central question: Is LLM-generated persuasion more difficult to automatically detect than human-written persuasion?

pmc-10669518.title: Posturography Approaches: An Insightful Window to Explore the Role of the Brain in Socio-Affective Processes
pmc-10669518.creator: Harold Mouras, Alexandre Vonesch, Karina Lebel, Guillaume Léonard, Thierry Lelard, Alessandro Grecucci
pmc-10669518.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). A significant amount of research has highlighted the importance of a motor component in the brain’s processing of emotional, motivational and social information. Posturography has emerged as an interesting way to assess motor correlates associated with this process. In this review, we highlight recent results within the functional context of painful stimulus perception and discuss the interest in broadening the use of posturography to other motivational and societal functional contexts.

pmc-11713166.title: Is there Evidence for a Continued Benefit for Long‐Term Lecanemab Treatment? A Benefit/Risk Update from Long‐Term Efficacy, Safety and Biomarker Data
pmc-11713166.creator: Christopher H van Dyck, Reisa A Sperling, Shobha Dhadda, David Li, Steven Hersch, Michael C Irizarry, Lynn D Kramer
pmc-11713166.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Lecanemab, a humanized IgG1 monoclonal antibody that binds with high affinity to amyloid‐beta (Aβ) protofibrils, was formally evaluated as a treatment for early Alzheimer’s disease in a phase 2 study (Study 201) and the phase 3 Clarity AD study. These trials both included an 18‐month, randomized study (core) and an open‐label extension (OLE) phase where eligible participants received open‐label lecanemab for up to 30 months to date.

pmc-12452307.title: An Update on New Approaches to Cognitive Assessment in Multiple Sclerosis
pmc-12452307.creator: Jacob Balconi, Dawn Langdon, Bishal Dhakal, Ralph H B Benedict, Fabrizio Michetti
pmc-12452307.description: Accessible, dependable cognitive assessment is integral to patient care of people with multiple sclerosis (PwMS). Traditional neuropsychological tests are well validated in the multiple sclerosis (MS) population, but not without limitations, such as the time and financial cost associated with traditional in person administration.

pmc-12608953.title: Expanding the Armamentarium: Perspectives on Buccal Mucosal Grafts and Appendiceal Flaps in Ureteral Reconstructive Surgery
pmc-12608953.creator: Dario Bello, Monica Van Shufflin, Matthias D. Hofer
pmc-12608953.description: Management of complex and recurrent ureteral stricture disease remains one of the more challenging aspects of reconstructive urology. While standard techniques such as ureteroureterostomy, psoas hitch, Boari flap, and ileal ureter creation serve as the foundation of ureteral reconstruction, each technique has limitations, particularly when faced with recurrence, long strictures, and previously irradiated fields.

pmc-12717316.title: Pharmacological inhibition of Ubiquitin-Specific Peptidase 10 (USP10) with spautin-1 attenuates adipogenesis through CCAAT/Enhancer-Binding Protein Beta (C/EBPβ) destabilization
pmc-12717316.creator: Zolzaya Erdenebileg, Desy Damayanti Simamora, Joong-Kwon Park, Rosana Nogueira, Young Bin Kim, Jeong-Yun Choi, Hyeon-Gu Kang, Hack Sun Choi, Jung-Hwan Baek, Kyung-Hee Chun
pmc-12717316.description: The pharmacological control of lipid accumulation in white adipose tissue (WAT) is a key area of focus in obesity research, yet the role of deubiquitination in adipocyte lipid storage remains underexplored. We found that spautin-1, an inhibitor of the deubiquitinases ubiquitin-specific peptidase 10 (USP10) and 13 (USP13), suppressed lipid accumulation during adipogenesis.

pmc-13622350.title: Surviving institutional contradictions: routine data use practices at the subnational levels
pmc-13622350.creator: Bigten Kikoba, Merina Luambano, Masoud Mahundi, Wilfred Senyoni
pmc-13622350.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Routine Health Information System data are widely promoted as a foundation for evidence-informed planning, supervision, and service improvement in low- and middle-income countries. Yet their use in decentralized health systems is often shaped by contradictory institutional logics. In this study, contradictory institutional logics refer to conflicting expectations about what actors should prioritize, how data should be used, and which resources are made available to do so.

pmc-13679325.title: Longitudinal peripheral DNA methylation remodeling following ketamine-assisted psychotherapy in major depressive disorder
pmc-13679325.creator: Arghavan Nepton, Sonya C. Faber, Zachary Kaminsky, Mario Nucci, Hesam Farahani, Monnica T. Williams, Sergio R. Perez Rosal
pmc-13679325.description: Ketamine produces rapid antidepressant effects, but the molecular processes associated with their persistence remain poorly defined in humans. We examined longitudinal DNA methylation changes in 10 adults with major depressive disorder undergoing ketamine-assisted psychotherapy using two pre-treatment assessments (T1, T2) and one post-treatment assessment (T3). Participants received three sessions of intranasal racemic ketamine within a structured psychotherapy protocol.

pmc-13680310.title: Combined eye tracking and electroencephalography during referential selection in dyadic interaction
pmc-13680310.creator: Ingmar Brilmayer, Philip Georgis, Petra B Schumacher
pmc-13680310.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Understanding language in real-world interaction requires methods that integrate auditory, visual, and neural signals. We present a proof-of-concept study combining mobile electroencephalography (EEG) and eye tracking to investigate referential selection during dyadic communication.

pmc-13685227.title: Randomised, placebo-controlled study to assess the safety and efficacy of Enterosgel® in the treatment of functional abdominal pain in children and young people (ENTOPIC): study protocol for a clinical trial
pmc-13685227.creator: Carol A. Howell, Manjula Velayudhan Nair, Marcus Karl‐Heinz Auth, Christine Spray, Dharamveer Basude, Matthew Dodd, Elena Markaryan, Radovan Hnatič, Stephen J. Allen
pmc-13685227.description: BackgroundFunctional abdominal pain disorders (FAPDs) comprise of irritable bowel syndrome, functional dyspepsia, abdominal migraine and functional abdominal pain not otherwise specified. FAPDs are common in children worldwide, decrease health related quality of life, reduce attendance and participation in school and after-school activities similar to children with inflammatory bowel disease, and incur significant health care costs.

uslaw-usc-t19-s2578b.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t19-s2578b.description: United States Code, Title 19 (Customs Duties); Chapter 13 (Trade Agreements Act Of 1979); Subchapter II (Technical Barriers To Trade (Standards)); Part F (International Standard-Setting Activities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In general As used in this part: (1) Agency The term “agency” means a Federal department or agency (or combination of Federal departments or agencies). (2) Commissioner The term “Commissioner”.
